headline.en: Reimagining product experiences with AI Agents

subheadline.zh: 朗新科技集团 AI 高级产品专家 · 江南大学控制工程硕士。专注 AI 产品与 Agent 产品设计，从业务洞察、AI 场景定义、Agent 架构到产品交付的一体化落地。个人产品「观赛官 GameSense」AI OPC 实践者。
subheadline.en: Senior AI Product Expert @ Longshine Technology · M.S. in Control Engineering @ Jiangnan University. Focused on AI & Agent product design — from insight, scenario definition and agent architecture to delivery. Practicing AI OPC with my product GameSense.

paragraphs.zh: 5+ 年产品、数据与 AI 相关经验，江南大学控制工程硕士，现任朗新科技集团 AI 高级产品专家，工作重心已由可信数据空间产品规划转向 AI 产品与智能体产品设计。具备从业务洞察、AI 场景定义、产品 / Agent 架构、Prompt 与上下文工程，到原型 Demo、研发协同与产品交付的完整 AI 产品落地能力。
paragraphs.en: 5+ years across product, data and AI. M.S. in Control Engineering from Jiangnan University; currently Senior AI Product Expert at Longshine Technology, where my focus has shifted from trusted data space products to AI products and agent product design — covering the full AI product delivery loop: business insight, scenario definition, product/agent architecture, prompt & context engineering, prototypes, R&D collaboration and shipping.

paragraphs.zh: 近一年重点负责 AI Agent 平台、AI 时代数据中台及 AI Native 产品规划与落地，并通过个人产品「观赛官 GameSense」实践 AI OPC（一人公司）；同时拥有能源数据、可信数据空间及复杂 B/C 端产品经验，持续研究 Agent Harness / Runtime、RAG / Graph RAG、Ontology、Workflow、A2A、AI Coding 等 AI 原生技术体系。
paragraphs.en: In the past year I have led the planning and delivery of an AI Agent platform, an AI-era data platform, and AI-native products — while practicing AI OPC (one-person company) with my own product GameSense. I also bring deep experience in energy data, trusted data spaces and complex B/C-end products, and keep researching AI-native stacks: Agent Harness/Runtime, RAG/Graph RAG, ontology, workflow, A2A and AI coding.

paragraphs.zh: 学生时期在 B 站做视频累计获得 30+ 万播放；曾与朋友共同创业，具备较强的管理、沟通与跨团队协作能力。
paragraphs.en: During college I created Bilibili videos with 300K+ cumulative views, and co-founded a startup with friends — sharpening my management, communication and cross-team collaboration skills.

name.zh: 观赛官 GameSense · AI 足球内容与智能应用

description.zh: 个人独立主导的 AI 足球产品，也是一次 AI OPC（一人公司）实践——用 AI 覆盖产品设计、开发、工作流、内容生产与运营增长。已上线 Web、H5、微信小程序，拥有 100+ 稳定用户，全平台累计粉丝约 1,000。独立负责产品定位、需求分析、信息架构、交互与版本规划，使用 AI Coding 完成主要 Web / H5 前端代码；设计赛事数据、新闻、球队、社媒热点等数据工作流（抓取、清洗、结构化、AI 加工与内容生成）；提供完整赛程、积分榜、比赛详情、国家队巡礼及 AI 教练室、AI 解说员、AI 问球等 AI Native 功能；并负责公众号、小红书、抖音等渠道运营获客与迭代。
description.en: An AI football product I independently lead — also my AI OPC (one-person company) practice, using AI across product design, development, workflows, content production and growth. Live on Web, H5 and WeChat Mini Program with 100+ active users and ~1,000 followers across platforms. I own positioning, requirements, information architecture, interaction and roadmap, and used AI coding to build the main Web/H5 frontend; designed data workflows for fixtures, news, teams and social trends (crawl → clean → structure → AI processing → content generation); shipped full schedules, standings, match details and national team profiles, plus AI-native features (AI Coach, AI Commentator, AI Q&A); and run WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Douyin channels for acquisition and iteration.

name.zh: AI Agent 平台 · 能源数据运营智能底座
name.en: AI Agent Platform · Energy Data Intelligence

description.zh:
面向能源数据运营及复杂业务场景建设 AI Agent 平台。包括政策智能问答、数据目录分析、行业信息研判、长任务执行、证据报告生成等场景的智能应用。
参考 DeepSeek Harness 的 Harness + Plugin 思路重塑 Agent Runtime：将 Workflow、Subagent、Jobs 等扩展能力插件化，形成“稳定 Runtime Core + 可插拔能力扩展”，显著提升长任务执行、上下文管理、异常恢复与运行稳定性。规划智能应用层、智能平台层、Agent Harness / Runtime 与数据知识能力层，涵盖 Agent Loop、Session、Context、Plugin Context、Checkpoint / Resume、Compaction、Workspace、Agent API / SSE 等能力，并结合 RAG / Graph RAG、知识图谱、本体增强业务语义理解；
description.en: An AI Agent platform for energy data operations and complex business scenarios. Redesigned the Agent Runtime inspired by DeepSeek Harness (Harness + Plugin): workflows, subagents, jobs and other extensions are pluginized into a stable runtime core with pluggable capabilities — greatly improving long-task execution, context management, crash recovery and stability. Planned layers: intelligent apps, platform services, Agent Harness/Runtime and data-knowledge capabilities — covering Agent Loop, Session, Context, Plugin Context, Checkpoint/Resume, Compaction, Workspace, Agent API/SSE — enriched by RAG/Graph RAG, knowledge graphs and ontology for business semantics. Smart apps cover policy Q&A, data catalog analysis, industry intelligence, long-running tasks and evidence-based report generation.

name.zh: 朗新能源智数 · AI 时代的数据中台
name.en: Lanshun Energy Zhishu · Data Platform for the AI Era

description.zh: 面向能源数据运营及 AI 应用建设的新一代数据智能底座。以 FastData 数据工程能力为执行内核、能源本体为统一数据组织方式，将传统以表、字段、任务、API 为中心的数据中台升级为面向数据、语义、知识、资产、产品与 AI 持续运营的数据智能平台。负责产品升级方向、产品定义、总体架构、能力地图、信息架构及 12 个月 Roadmap；引入能源本体、统一实体标识、Schema 语义映射、知识图谱、指标字典与业务规则，让跨系统能源数据从“机器可读取”走向“机器可理解”；规划 AI 辅助语义映射、质量问题定位、规则推荐及平台智能助手；设计“数据接入 → 标准治理 → 语义治理 → 加工建模 → 数据集 → 数据资产 → 数据产品 → 运营反馈”完整闭环。
description.en: A next-gen data intelligence foundation for energy data operations and AI applications — FastData as the execution core, energy ontology as the unified data organization. It upgrades the traditional table/field/task/API-centric data platform into one continuously operating on data, semantics, knowledge, assets, products and AI. I own the upgrade direction, product definition, overall architecture, capability map, IA and a 12-month roadmap; introduced energy ontology, unified entity IDs, schema semantic mapping, knowledge graphs, metric dictionaries and business rules so cross-system energy data goes from machine-readable to machine-understandable; planned AI-assisted semantic mapping, quality issue localization, rule recommendations and a platform assistant; designed the full loop: ingestion → standard governance → semantic governance → modeling → datasets → assets → products → feedback.

name.zh: 国网能源行业可信数据空间
name.en: Trusted Data Space for Energy (State Grid)

description.zh: 国家电网行业级数据要素基础设施项目，构建跨主体、跨区域的数据可信流通与安全使用体系。主导可信数据空间总体功能体系规划与架构设计，覆盖主体可信连接、资源管理、产品管理、共享流通、可信管控、门户及运营管理等能力；深度参与南瑞、国网相关单位及网省协同，完成项目方案、产品设计及可运行 Web Demo；主导/参与《可信数据空间建设方案》、业务需求规格说明书及相关标准机制设计；参与中汽研汽车可信数据空间与国网可信数据空间互联互通方案。
description.en: A State Grid industry-level data-element infrastructure project building cross-entity, cross-region trusted data circulation and secure usage. I led the overall functional system planning and architecture — trusted entity connection, resource management, product management, sharing & circulation, trusted governance, portal and operations; worked closely with NARI, State Grid units and provincial/city grids, delivering solutions, product design and a runnable Web demo; led/contributed to the construction blueprint, business requirements specs and standards; and joined the interoperability design between CATARC automotive and State Grid trusted data spaces.

description.zh: 赴沙特开展现场需求调研，负责 MaaS 行业研究、需求分析、产品功能、原型与交互设计；长期直接与海外客户沟通，协同 UI/UX、研发及测试团队推进交付，积累国际化移动端产品及复杂出行业务经验。
description.en: Conducted on-site requirements research in Saudi Arabia; owned MaaS industry research, requirements analysis, product features, prototyping and interaction design; communicated directly with overseas clients, coordinating UI/UX, R&D and QA to ship — building international mobile product experience in complex mobility businesses.

description.zh: 建立 AI 辅助产品经理工作流，将 AI 应用于需求分析、竞品研究、架构设计、原型、PRD、解决方案与 Demo 开发；推动 ChatGPT(Codex)、Claude、Cursor 等 AI 工具在产品及业务团队中的应用，开展 AI 产品方法与工具培训；负责业务线 AI 创新方向研究，持续跟踪基础模型、Agent、AI Infra、RAG、知识图谱及 AI Coding 技术趋势；AI 创新项目入选集团“智赢未来奖”并进入前三。
description.en: Established an AI-augmented PM workflow applying AI to requirements, competitive research, architecture, prototypes, PRDs, solutions and demo development; drove adoption of ChatGPT (Codex), Claude and Cursor across product & business teams with hands-on training; led AI innovation research for the business line, tracking foundation models, agents, AI infra, RAG, knowledge graphs and AI coding trends; the AI innovation project won the group’s “Smart Win Future” award, ranking top three.
